title: Browser per-process cold first-snapshot excess on binary B7: fresh pre-registered run (P2 after snapshot1, 3 classes x 32 Williams rounds) plus a one-binary E2 re-read
lineage: B-04 / B-06 (per-process cold excess), B-07 (transport sub-span verdicts on the same binary B7)

advances.E2: a pre-registered terminal verdict (OWNER_DECISION or NOT_MATERIAL) for the per-process cold excess in fill / toggle / modal, without B-06's post-hoc Amendment 1; and the browser scripted untested share per class recomputed on one binary (B7) that carries B-07's transport verdicts
advances.E1: terminal disposition for the B-04 / B-06 lineage

new_preregistration: This is a NEW pre-registration, not an amendment of B-06. B-06's primary was UNDECIDED because its positive control sat before snapshot1 and overlapped the first snapshot's wait. NO amendment is permitted in this lane: a failed control ends as UNDECIDED and is reported, never re-specified.

hypothesis.H1: a fresh Driver process pays a per-process cold first-snapshot excess D = T_j(C) - T_j(Wa) > 0 in every browser class; D can be removed only by reusing the Driver/Chrome process across tasks, outside T
hypothesis.carried: the per-document part is IRREDUCIBLE (B-04, carried by SOURCE)

source.tested_sha_note: R' 45dff8f32 + B-05 mark picks (a17530466 / c65b1d2f2 / 501158460) + the default-off POST_FAST knob (B-07)
source.relation_to_R_prime: B7's relation to R' (922111c5) rests only on B-07's default-off smoke (SOURCE); absolute T is never compared with B-06 or R2-10R
source.build: none; nothing is built in this lane

binary.name: cua-driver-b07-231f6e8bb
binary.rule: re-hashed on the host at lane start and end; inside every session the runner refuses on a sha256 mismatch and records name, sha256 and version in every trial record and chunk manifest

harness.copied: first commit: B-06's run_b06.py, b06_rows.py, harness/, lane-scripts/, r10r_observation.py from 31bc98a95 (blob ids in provenance.json); every later change is a reviewed diff (git log -p)
harness.pilot: 28 trials (plan pilot: rounds 0 and 5 of the measured plan, SHARED lock, label b08-pilot-r00-05, load rule disabled with --load-max 100) ran before this PREREG to check the receipts; excluded from every analysis; it set no gate, threshold or rule; analyze_b08.py ran once on the pilot trials (SHARED lock b08-analyze-pilot) to check the analysis pipeline only

configuration.identical_in_every_measured_arm: R2-10 scripted COMP: feedback OFF (set_agent_cursor_enabled false), focus settle 0 on fill, 10 ms completion poll with a 2.0 s deadline, caller-compiled output validators, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1, guarded completion + compiled replay on fill (R2-10R scripted COMP artifact), R2-10 step loop on toggle / modal
configuration.phase_trace: on (CUA_DRIVER_PHASE_TRACE_FILE per trial), including the B-05 / B-07 transport marks compiled into B7
configuration.caller_stamps: B-07 stamped stdio client, default variant (PREP_FAST off, ROUTE_FAST off)
configuration.telemetry: CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false in CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV and in the Driver environment; DO_NOT_TRACK=1
configuration.provider: no provider key forwarded; TypeSafe cap 0

arms.fresh: every trial: fresh cua-driver mcp, fresh Driver-launched system Chrome (browser_prepare allow_launch, profile isolated_new, sandbox on), fresh fixture servers, fresh token, fresh session label
arms.C: cold: the task document is the process's first
arms.Wa: warm: OUTSIDE T, browser_navigate to B-04's matched-content sibling page, then one semantic_v2 snapshot; the warm-up is timed separately (warmup_start -> warmup_end); then the task browser_navigate in the same tab, Driver and Chrome
arms.Wb: identical to Wa, second A/A label
arms.P2: Wa plus a 15.0 ms CLOCK_MONOTONIC sleep inside T, placed immediately after snapshot1 returns; the measured sleep is recorded per trial
arms.SMOKE: product default (no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, feedback on, 100 ms poll, library validation), cold, 5 per class; correctness only

forced_path.route_and_producer: per accepted action: Driver receipt route (fill browser_type trusted_input then browser_click dom; toggle / modal browser_click dom, dom), the Driver dispatch mark inside the call window (click.cdp_send / type.insert_send), the decision producer (compiled / provider / guarded-completion) and the candidate input_route
forced_path.cold_warm_attribution: snapshot1 phase marks: CDP session attach (snap.enter -> snap.attached), DOM.getDocument (snap.attached -> snap.document), AX tree fetch (snap.indexed -> snap.ax_cdp_done); B-04 E estimator span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2)
forced_path.process_identity: Driver pid and Chrome browser pid with /proc start time, after the warm-up and immediately before the task navigate; warm arms identical at both points

design.square: 4x4 Williams square over C/Wa/Wb/P2 (rc.williams(4) rows [0,1,3,2],[1,2,0,3],[2,3,1,0],[3,0,2,1]; index 0=C,1=Wa,2=Wb,3=P2); round r, class k (fill 0, toggle 1, modal 2) runs row (r + k) mod 4
design.rounds: 32 rounds per class (8 squares), rounds 0-31; every contrast has 32 pairs per class
design.class_order: rotates per round: r mod 3 = 0 fill,toggle,modal; 1 toggle,modal,fill; 2 modal,fill,toggle
design.smoke: one SMOKE trial per class (fill, toggle, modal) at the end of rounds 0-4 (15 trials)
design.nw2: one N-W2 control at the end of round 5 (fill), 6 (toggle), 7 (modal)
design.session: 0-3 s random start jitter before each private Xvfb session and an xdpyinfo probe before any trial (session-retry.sh, in-session.sh)
design.chunks: each measured chunk = one EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed acquisition (label b08-<chunk>, <= 600 s via timeout) with the cargo-build lock tried INSIDE it by flock -w 60 (not acquired: exit 74, nothing runs, quiet released, retry later); the runner starts no round past a 450 s budget; rounds not started are run in a later chunk
design.round_attempts: a round is atomic for the load rule (checked before the round). If a round is cut (time cap, crash, session failure) its trials are kept in raw/ and reported, and the round index is re-run with attempt+1. For each round the analysis uses the first attempt listed as completed in its chunk manifest; validity is judged inside it (failed trials stay in the denominators). Trials of cut attempts are counted separately

load_rule.rule: a round starts only when the 1-min loadavg (/proc/loadavg field 1) is <= 4.0; the runner polls every 1 s for up to 60 s; if still > 4.0 it ends the chunk (exit 75), both locks are released, and the same round index resumes later
load_rule.logging: every load check (round, UTC, load1, waited_s) is in the chunk manifest; loadavg before/after is in every trial record
load_rule.sensitivity: descriptive view of every gate and contrast without rounds containing a trial whose 1-min loadavg_before is > 4.0

oracle.owner: target-owned, independent of the Driver: the jev-use / #24 fixture server state and its CLOCK_MONOTONIC journal (fill submitted == token; toggle checked; modal action applied)
oracle.validity_core: oracle-verified (expected final state, exact match) with exactly one completion mutation in the journal
oracle.PRIMARY_T_j: T_j = max(journal completion ts, caller-side return of the last accepted mutation) - task_start, task_start = return of the task browser_navigate; journal and caller stamps are time.monotonic_ns (CLOCK_MONOTONIC) in one process; replaces B-06's 2 ms grid
oracle.SECONDARY_T_oracle: first expected-state sample of the 2 ms sampler at/after the caller-side return of the last accepted mutation, minus task_start (B-04/B-06 rule)
oracle.agreement_check: |T_j - T_oracle| <= 2.5 ms in >= 95% of valid measured trials (C/Wa/Wb/P2); if it fails it is a disclosed deviation and the gates still use T_j

validity: b04_rows.row validity (verified outcome, exact oracle match, T_oracle present, no revert after ok, exactly 1 completion mutation, no stale dispatch, expected action routes, configuration receipts of the arm, 0 non-loopback connects) with the telemetry receipt 'false', AND T_j defined (exactly one journal completion and >= 1 accepted mutation), AND pids_ok, AND the trial record's Driver name / sha256 / version equal the PREREG binary, AND caller variant default (no PREP_FAST / ROUTE_FAST taken), AND (P2: the sleep was measured), AND every E4 counter 0. Failed trials stay in every denominator

definitions.stale_dispatch: b04_rows: an action not immediately preceded by a task observation, an action error, or a failed action call
definitions.ambiguous_dispatch: an action call that returned a non-refusal error or never returned (effect unknown), or a trial that ended unreconciled (outcome not verified / refuted / abstained) after >= 1 accepted dispatch
definitions.unverified_success: runner outcome verified without an exact oracle match
definitions.blind_replay: the same (tool, candidate) accepted more than once in a trial (compiled-replay steps keyed by tool)
definitions.refusal_returned_as_success: an action call that returned ok with effect or status 'refused'

e4.gate: every counter 0 in every arm (C, Wa, Wb, P2, SMOKE) of every class

statistics.pairing: paired within-round differences per (class, round): the two arms' T_j; a pair needs both trials valid
statistics.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap of the median, 10000 resamples, a fresh random.Random(20261003) for every contrast, 95% CI = [sorted[250], sorted[9749]]

gates.NC: per class: the 95% CI of median paired (Wa - Wb) lies inside [-2.0, +2.0] ms
gates.PC2: per class: median paired (P2 - Wa) lies in [12, 18] ms AND its 95% CI excludes 0
gates.validity: per class, every arm C, Wa, Wb, P2 >= 95% valid (32 trials each); SMOKE reported per class

verdict_rules.per_class: computed only when NC, PC2, validity and E4 pass in that class; if NC or PC2 fails: UNDECIDED naming the failed control(s); if validity or E4 fails: UNDECIDED naming that gate
verdict_rules.D: median paired (C - Wa) T_j with its 95% CI; T_C = median T_j over valid C trials of the class
verdict_rules.OWNER_DECISION: CI(D) lower bound > 1.0 ms AND (median D >= 5% of T_C OR median D >= 50 ms): process/session reuse kept outside T is product policy
verdict_rules.NOT_MATERIAL: CI(D) upper bound < 5% of T_C AND < 50 ms: the per-process part is IRREDUCIBLE at material scale
verdict_rules.replicate: D' = median paired (C - Wb) is reported (descriptive, no gate)

disposition.KEEP: every class reaches a terminal per-process verdict (OWNER_DECISION or NOT_MATERIAL), NC and PC2 pass, validity passes, E4 = 0, SMOKE 5/5 per class verified, N-W2 1/1 per class pass
disposition.REVISE: otherwise, naming the failing gate per class

controls.negative: the NC A/A pair (Wa vs Wb)
controls.positive: PC2 (P2 vs Wa, 15.0 ms in T right after snapshot1)
controls.fix01_nw2: FIX-01 detached-node refusal carry-over (B-02 N-W2, run_b02.control_one unchanged, COMP admission knob), 1 per class: the node is replaced between snapshot and action; pass = stale action effect=refused, 0 completion mutations from it (0 detached effects), the marker visible in a fresh snapshot, and the action re-derived from it verified with exactly one completion mutation
controls.smoke: 5 per class, oracle-verified with exactly one completion mutation, no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* and 0 mcp.inner_validation_skipped marks

part_E.class: BENCHMARK analysis of this lane's own C and Wa arms only (binary B7); nothing is added to or ratioed with another lane's or binary's numbers
part_E.T: R2-10 T_runner (snapshot1 send -> verified oracle read) per valid C / Wa trial with phase trace; rows with B-05 coverage < 0.98 are excluded and counted
part_E.decomposition: R2-10 e2_components (harness/r2-10r/analyze_r2_10.py on the R2-10 mark view) plus the B-05/B-07 transport sub-spans (harness/b05/b05_spans.decompose_b05, B-07's units); per-trial consistency = max |sum of sub-spans per component - R2-10 component|
part_E.views: PRIMARY corrected at c_m = median of this lane's in-situ null-pair intervals over the C and Wa trials (B-07 method: every interval that starts at a Driver mark minus c_m; T_runner_corr = T_runner - marks x c_m); SECONDARY raw (marks on)
part_E.cold_excess: E = span(snapshot1) - span(snapshot2) per trial (B-04 estimator, b04_rows excess_b03_ms), mean per arm; it sits inside the observation component. Wa: E_Wa = cold per-document (IRREDUCIBLE, B-04). C: cold per-process = max(0, mean E_C - mean E_Wa), cold per-document = mean E_C - cold per-process; the per-process part takes this lane's verdict (OWNER_DECISION -> OWNER_DECISION; NOT_MATERIAL -> IRREDUCIBLE; UNDECIDED* -> UNTESTED); the rest of observation is IRREDUCIBLE (B-04)
part_E.sensitivity: C view with the per-process part sized by max(0, median D) (T_j) instead of the snapshot1 E difference, reported when the verdict is not terminal
part_E.untested_share: untested ms / mean T_runner (view), for C (the composed task: a fresh process) and for Wa, with BELOW_GATE counted as IRREDUCIBLE and as UNTESTED
part_E.list: every R2-10 component and every lane-scope unit with mean >= 5% of mean T or >= 50 ms, with its verdict and source lane

admission tools-list cache: DELETED (already on: the deleted re-validation is not in T; receipt mcp.inner_validation_skipped)

res.frame_proof: B-07 (invariant: Page.getFrameTree re-proves the ref's frame identity)
res.editable_check: B-07 (invariant: non-editable targets refused before typing)

verdict_map.carry_check: the B-07 labels above are the ones in b07-summary.json @ eab1e87a3 (verdicts.units / verdicts.resolution), except c_in.prep on fill (UNTESTED here by rule); a carried BELOW_GATE unit whose corrected mean in this lane is >= 0.5 ms is flagged descriptively, never relabelled

descriptive: per-arm snapshot1 split (attach, DOM.getDocument, AX tree) and snapshot1 span
median T_j and T_oracle per arm
T_j source (journal vs caller return) counts

claim_boundary: one shared host, private Xvfb, system Chrome 151, binary B7 only, scripted chooser; the verdict covers process reuse outside T for a single task and does not design or endorse a warm pool, a session lifecycle or any new service; no Driver behaviour change; instrumentation is the existing env-gated, default-off phase trace and caller-side stamps
